prompt:
你是独立查新复核者。用户要求：重查最接近工作，明确判断3DGS分裂机制是否值得做，给有依据切入点，找不到就直接建议换题。只读，不跑GPU，不写文件；请用primary sources核验关键判断，中文简洁答复。
当前发现：泛化的改split方向/数量/保留父代/冷却/频率误差gate均有近邻。候选唯一较明确未解决问题：SAD-GS §4.4承认逐Gaussian频率判据忽略重叠primitive collective support造成过增密。拟研究定义：对SAD提出的parent–axis split，估计在当前重叠集合下的边际频带重建收益，早期执行必要split。尚无具体低成本估计器；不能仅band residual×contribution门控，也不能宣称已是创新方法。
主要primary：SAD-GS https://arxiv.org/html/2604.28016v1 (SIGGRAPH2026), §4.4说collective support及渐进edge分裂收敛慢；Neural Gabor Splatting https://arxiv.org/html/2604.15941v1 (2026-04-17预印本) §4.2 Eq8–9联合render/GT三band残差按primitive贡献归因做clone/split，2DGS+neural appearance。SIG https://arxiv.org/html/2607.01698v1 ICLR2026，§3.2Eq3–5从联合opacity Fourier power出发，近似丢cross terms，单体bandwidth全局加权统计，用于resolution/densify调度。Spectral-GS https://arxiv.org/html/2409.12771v1 单体cov谱/针状；EntON https://arxiv.org/html/2603.06216v1 kNN中心几何entropy；FreGS https://arxiv.org/html/2403.06908v2 频率监督。
其他closest：SteepGS https://arxiv.org/html/2505.05587v1 已有全nGaussian参数mean-shift与零均值split二阶分解，不能说忽略neighbors；实际perGaussian3x3 splitting matrix负特征值。BOGausS https://arxiv.org/html/2504.01844v1 optimizer/splitstateinherit；DC4GS https://arxiv.org/html/2510.26921v1 gradientdirection/costoptimalunequalsplit；AdpSplit https://arxiv.org/html/2605.06876v1 adaptiveN/location/shape保留parent副本；ResGS https://arxiv.org/html/2412.07494v2 residualparent；DART https://www.mdpi.com/2313-433x/12/10/483 cooldown；最新CountingContributions https://arxiv.org/html/2610.27108v1 (10/19preprint)实际Talpha贡献归一化；ConfidenceAware https://arxiv.org/html/2610.13541v1 (10/9preprint)fixedbudgeterror/confidencerelocation。
本地先前两种方法(邻居Jacobian投影选点/跨视角梯度协方差方向)Truck/Train短试无稳定收益。20case有限优化比较1可替代/0确认split优势/14split收益不足/4不一致/1外部退化，且Truck浮点约束回退10.1%。只能说没支撑当前方法，不否定整个分裂领域，也没有测试SAD候选。
请回答：1候选precise delta是否被上述直接包含？2有没有足以立即立项的机制而非problemstatement？3给novelty verdict与资源决策分开判断（可建议停止当前主线，但不得因拥挤就判全领域无价值）。4用户要直接答案，应该继续、限时新问题机制推导，还是当前换题？不要为了安慰制造创新，也不要要求研究前已经实验证明新方法有效。给最强反方与有根据结论。
=== NOVELTY VERDICT LIMITS (these bound how you judge, never how widely you search) ===
Search exhaustively; judge calibrated. Two failures waste months equally:
passing an idea a published paper already contains, and killing a viable idea
because the territory has neighbors.
1. Proximity is information, not a verdict. Someone working nearby goes in the
   report; it is not by itself a reason to reject.
2. ABANDON has exactly one qualification: a specific published paper already
   contains this result — name that paper. No named paper, no ABANDON.
3. Crowded-but-deltaed is PROCEED: state the delta in one sentence a reviewer
   could verify. Thin or contested delta is PROCEED WITH CAUTION — say what
   would make it carry, not why it should die. CAUTION is not a safe middle:
   if you cannot name the specific thing that makes the delta thin, the
   verdict is PROCEED.
4. Concurrent or competing work is not a veto. That is a race — report it and
   let the user decide whether to run it.
5. A direct attack on a central problem is legitimate novelty when nobody has
   executed it well. "This area is hot" does not mean "this area is taken."
6. This check is an early gate, never the last one — more triage, pilots, or
   external review still stand between any idea and a paper, whatever order
   this run uses. A wrongly passed idea dies cheaply at one of them; a wrongly
   killed idea is never seen again. When torn between two verdicts, choose the
   more permissive one.
Say plainly when an idea clears the check. Do not manufacture overlap.
